claims: The University of Pennsylvania is a private Ivy League research university in Philadelphia.
The University of Pennsylvania was founded in 1740 by Benjamin Franklin.
The University of Pennsylvania has the Wharton School.
The University of Pennsylvania has the Perelman School of Medicine.
The University of Pennsylvania has a nursing school.
The University of Pennsylvania has a 5.4% acceptance rate for recent cycles.
The University of Pennsylvania is ranked #7 among national universities.
For the 2023-2024 academic year, tuition at the University of Pennsylvania was approximately $66,104.
2023-24 averages for Reading/Writing scores of admitted students at the University of Pennsylvania are between 740-770.
2023-24 averages for Math scores of admitted students at the University of Pennsylvania are between 770-800.
The University of Pennsylvania has an urban campus located in West Philadelphia.
The University of Pennsylvania campus is characterized by the historic Locust Walk.
The University of Pennsylvania has over $800 million in research funding.
Roughly 13% of students at the University of Pennsylvania are international students.
